{{missingInfo|1|enva}} {{AnimePokémonInfobox |type1=Rock |trainername=Murdock |pokemonname=Lycanroc |jtrainername=マードック |jpokemonname=ルガルガン |tmtrainername=Murdoch |tmpokemonname=Lugarugan |image=[[File:Murdock Lycanroc.png|250px]] |caption=Murdock's Lycanroc |location=Unknown |gender=Unknown |prevonum=0744 |evo1num=745 |evolution=1 |firstevoep= HZ098 |firstevoname=Reunion in Cortondo |firstevonametiming=Prior to |firststagename=Rockruff |numeps1=between 90 and 97 |epnum=HZ002 |epname=The Pendant That Starts It All (Part Two) |current=[[Party|With Murdock]] |java1=[[List of Japanese voice actors|Risaki Furuichi]] |enva1=[[Haven Paschall]] |enva2=Unknown |java2=[[Tasuku Hatanaka]] }} '''Murdock's Lycanroc''' (Japanese: '''マードックのルガルガン''' ''Murdoch's Lugarugan'') is [[Murdock]]'s partner and his first known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. It helps Murdock in finding various people or lost objects for the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]]. It is often seen [[Walking Pokémon|outside]] its {{i|Poké Ball}}. ==In animation== ===History=== [[File:Liko Rockruff.png|thumb|left|250px|Rockruff and [[Liko]]]] {{p|Lycanroc}} first appeared as a {{p|Rockruff}} in ''[[HZ002|The Pendant That Starts It All (Part Two)]]'', when it greeted [[Liko]] and her {{TP|Liko|Sprigatito}} when they arrived onboard the [[Brave Olivine]]. After greeting the {{pkmn|category|Grass Cat Pokémon}}, Rockruff joined in a game with Sprigatito, {{TP|Roy|Fuecoco}}, and {{p|Pawmi}}. In ''[[HZ003|For Sure! 'Cause Sprigatito's with Me!]]'', Rockruff joined in the search for Liko's Sprigatito after it had been taken as a hostage by the [[Explorers]]. By using its great sense of smell, Rockruff spotted [[Onia]] when she was out shopping and alerted the other members of the Rising Volt Tacklers who gave chase. Whilst [[Friede]] distracted [[Amethio]] by battling his {{TP|Amethio|Ceruledge}} with [[Captain Pikachu]], Rockruff helped Liko find and free Sprigatito. [[File:Chansey and Rockruff.png|thumb|250px|Rockruff and [[Mollie's Chansey]] ready to battle]] In ''[[HZ005|Found You, Fuecoco!]]'', Murdock used Rockruff to battle the Explorers when they confronted the Rising Volt Tacklers. It battled against [[Zirc]] and his {{p|Rhydon}}. However, despite holding its own, Rockruff couldn't beat Zirc's Rhydon and was carried back to the ship by Murdock. In ''[[HZ019|The Bittersweet Truth]]'', Rockruff stayed on the airship to get groomed by [[Mollie]] when Murdock, Liko, and [[Roy]] went to [[Motostoke]] to get supplies. [[File:Terapagos and Murdock Rockruff.png|thumb|250px|left|Rockruff and [[Pagogo|Terapagos]]]] In ''[[HZ030|Slip and Crash! A Mystery Pokémon?!]]'', Rockruff heard a noise as it got Liko and her Sprigatito attention, but the three didn't know where the noise was coming from. However, after Captain Pikachu and the Pokémon living on the Brave Olivine found out that a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Polteageist}} was behind the purple goo and the noise, Rockruff joined them and [[Pagogo|Terapagos]] in watching a battle between the Black Tea Pokémon and {{p|Shuckle}}. Although the battled was called off, Rockruff joined its friends in welcoming Polteageist to the group with Liko's Sprigatito, Roy's Fuecoco, and [[Dot's Quaxly]] joining them. In ''[[HZ032|Lapras's Feelings for its Friends]]'', Rockruff and [[Mollie's Chansey]] joined forces to fend off the attacking Pokémon sent by [[Lucius's Lapras]] who were trying to steal their supplies. While intimidated at first, Rockruff and Chansey nevertheless pushed through to defend their airship, with Chansey focusing on {{p|Octillery}} while Rockruff battled {{p|Barbaracle}}. [[File:Murdock Lycanroc overweight.png|thumb|250px|Lycanroc overweight]] In ''[[HZ033|Roar of the Black Rayquaza]]'', Rockruff and Terapagos got together to hold a meeting with the other Pokémon inside Brave Olivine. The party continued until the group was interrupted by {{p|Quaxly}} and soon after by [[Dot]], who caught all the mess the Pokémon made in Murdock's kitchen. In ''[[HZ098|Reunion in Cortondo]]'', Liko, Roy, and Dot arrived in [[Cortondo]] to find Murdock, discovering that Rockruff had [[Evolution|evolved]] into Lycanroc during the one year timeskip. Murdock stated that after working for Katy, he began experimenting recipes, with Rockruff being his taste tester. Eventually, during one of these taste tests, Rockruff inexplicably evolved into Lycanroc. Due to the heavy consumption of sweets, Lycanroc became obese. Lycanroc played with the group and their Pokémon before seeing them off. In ''[[HZ100|We Are the Rising Volt Tacklers!]]'', Lycanroc appeared alongside Murdock when he returned to the Rising Volt Tacklers. By this point, Lycanroc has slimmed down, making it appear more in-line with its species' general appearance. {{-}} ===Personality and characteristics=== [[File:Murdock and Lycanroc.png|thumb|250px|left|Lycanroc and Murdock]] [[File:Murdock Rockruff medical profile.png|thumb|250px|Rockruff's medical profile]] Lycanroc, while it was a Rockruff, is shown to be a playful Pokémon, as seen in ''[[HZ002|The Pendant That Starts It All (Part Two)]]'' when it played with [[Liko's Sprigatito]] and a few of the other Pokémon seen on the [[Brave Olivine]]. Despite its playful personality, Lycanroc is a serious Pokémon, as seen in ''[[HZ003|For Sure! 'Cause Sprigatito's with Me!]]'', when it joined in the search for Sprigatito. It is very eager and cannot help but restrain itself without command. Rockruff also likes to get groomed, as shown in ''[[HZ019|The Bittersweet Truth]]'', when it stayed on the Brave Olivine to get brushed by [[Mollie]]. Lycanroc has a great relationship with [[Murdock]] as it enjoys hanging out with him. It is also shown to have a sweet tooth. Due to its heavy consumption of sweets following Murdock's employment with [[Katy]], Lycanroc was larger and more obese than others of its kind, having a chubby face, large stomach and legs. However, prior to ''[[HZ100|We Are the Rising Volt Tacklers!]]'', Lycanroc was able to lose all the weight that it gained from eating all the sweets Murdock made. Lycanroc has become able to help Murdock carrying his supplies for the Brave Olivine, as seen in ''[[HZ109|Tinkatuff's Hammer Wasn't Made in a Year!]]''. Whenever Murdock was cooking something or someone was snooping around the kitchen, Lycanroc would make sure its Trainer wasn't disturbed and get them to leave, as seen in ''[[HZ004|The Treasure After the Storm!]]'', as well has protecting the food supply, that would usually be sneakly eaten by [[Roy's Fuecoco]]. Like its {{p|Rockruff|spe}}{{p|Lycanroc|cies}}, Lycanroc has a great sense of smell and has use it to help its Trainer and friends find something or someone. Despite being a {{type|Rock}}, Lycanroc isn't bothered by water, as seen in ''[[HZ105|Riding the Waves]]'', when it went surfing with Murdock. ===Appearance=== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{rock color}}; {{roundy}}; border: 3px solid #{{rock color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{rock color light}}; {{roundytop|5px}}" | As a {{pcolor|Rockruff|000}} |- style="background:#fff" | [[File:Murdock Rockruff.png|250px]] |} ===Moves used=== {{anmov/h|rock||Murdock Rockruff Rock Tomb.png|Using Rock Tomb

width:auto"| [[File:HZ eyecatch Murdock Rockruff.png|x150px]] |style="{{roundy|5px}} border: 2px solid #{{rock color dark}}; background: #{{rock color light}}; width:auto"| [[File:HZ eyecatch Murdock Lycanroc Alcremie.png|x150px]] |} ==In the manga== ===Pocket Monsters ~Pucchigumi SP~=== [[File:Liko Sprigatito Murdock Rockruff PGSP.png|200px|thumb|Rockruff in Pocket Monsters ~Pucchigumi SP~]] Rockruff appeared in [[PGSP01]] playing with {{TP|Liko|Sprigatito}}. ===Pocket Monsters ~The Detouring Volt Tacklers!!~=== [[File:Murdock Party DVT.png|thumb|left|200px|Murdock and his Pokémon in the [[Pocket Monsters ~The Detouring Volt Tacklers!!~]] manga]] Rockruff appeared in a cameo alongside {{TP|Murdock|Alcremie}} and [[Murdock]] in [[Pocket Monsters ~The Detouring Volt Tacklers!!~]]. {{-}} ==In the games== ===[[Pokémon GO]]=== On March 5, 2024, as part of Pokémon GO's [https://pokemongolive.com/post/pokemon-horizons-anime-celebration Pokémon Horizons: The Series Celebration Event], which was based on {{aniseries|HZ}}, several Pokémon based on those encountered in the animated series appeared more frequently in the wild, in {{GO|Raid Battle|raids}}, from [[List of Eggs in Pokémon GO|Eggs]], from [[Field Research]] tasks, and during [[Photography#Pokémon GO|surprise encounters]], with Rockruff appearing in level 1 raids and from Field Research tasks.
